context: Adds a per-request correlation ID that's automatically attached to every log line written during that request.
explanation: A clean, well-scoped change: AsyncLocalStorage propagates the request ID through async call chains without threading it through every function signature, the middleware reuses an inbound X-Request-Id header when present (useful behind a gateway) and echoes it back on the response, and pino's mixin hook attaches it to every log line without call-site changes. This makes it far easier to trace a single request's logs across services.
